institution: Rutgers - New Brunswick School of Arts and Sciences

required_computer_science_courses.title: Design and Analysis of Computer Algorithms

electives.notes: Chosen from a designated list of courses in computer science and related disciplines. At least 5 must be 01:198:xxx, with at least 2 at the 300 level or above.

science_requirement.description: Complete either an approved Physics sequence or an approved Chemistry sequence.

policies.grade_policy: No more than one grade of D can be accepted in courses applied toward the major.
policies.residency_requirement: At least seven of the required and elective courses used to satisfy the degree requirements must be taken in the New Brunswick Department of Computer Science (01:198:xxx).
policies.course_expiration: All CS electives required for the degree must have been completed within the last ten years preceding graduation.

courses.title: Introduction to Programming
courses.notes: Preparatory course for students needing additional programming experience; earns SAS credit only.
